prices.heading: Property prices in the Balkans
prices.seoTitle: Property Prices in the Balkans – Price per m² by Country and City
prices.intro: Median asking prices and rents of the live listings on BalkanEstateAI, by country and city, as of {{date}}.
prices.metaTail: Price per m², median asking price and median monthly rent for ten countries, with the method and a CSV download.
prices.notEnough: “–” means fewer than {{min}} listings with a price
prices.method1: Asking prices of the listings live on BalkanEstateAI on the date above — not completed sales, valuations or official statistics.
prices.method2: Each figure is a median: half of the listings ask more, half ask less.
prices.method3: Price per m² uses listings that state an area of at least 15 m². Weekly rents are converted to monthly; nightly stays are left out.
prices.method4: A figure is shown only when at least {{min}} listings back it.
prices.cite: You are welcome to quote them. Please cite “BalkanEstateAI, Property prices in the Balkans, {{date}}” with a link to this page.
